subject: math
domain: Conditional Probability and the Rules of Probability
cluster: Use the rules of probability to compute probabilities of compound events in a uniform probability model

items.prompt:
To compute $P(A\mid B)$ from counts, the denominator is the count of:
A) $A$
B) $B$
C) the grand total
D) $A$ and $B$

Of $20$ music students, $8$ play a sport. $P(\text{sport}\mid\text{music})$ is:
A) $0.2$
B) $0.4$
C) $0.8$
D) $0.08$

A die is odd. The probability it is a $1$ is:
A) $\frac{1}{6}$
B) $\frac{1}{3}$
C) $\frac{1}{2}$
D) $1$

Of $12$ dog owners, $3$ have a cat. $P(\text{cat}\mid\text{dog})$ is:
A) $\frac{1}{4}$
B) $\frac{1}{3}$
C) $\frac{3}{4}$
D) $\frac{1}{12}$

A die is greater than $3$. The probability it is even is:
A) $\frac{1}{3}$
B) $\frac{2}{3}$
C) $\frac{1}{2}$
D) $1$

Of $25$ runners, $5$ swim. $P(\text{swim}\mid\text{run})$ is:
A) $0.2$
B) $0.5$
C) $0.05$
D) $0.8$

Of $30$ students, $18$ passed and $9$ of those got an A. $P(\text{A}\mid\text{pass})$ is:
A) $0.3$
B) $0.5$
C) $0.9$
D) $0.18$

A die is greater than $2$. The probability it is a $5$ is:
A) $\frac{1}{6}$
B) $\frac{1}{4}$
C) $\frac{1}{3}$
D) $\frac{1}{2}$
